description: Record one piece of evidence — the sentence a CV bullet would carry. Only record what the CANDIDATE told you; the server stamps anything created here `manual`, which means they asserted it, and that stamp is what lets it be cited on a CV. A claim already in the bank, under any spelling, is refused as 409 rather than duplicated — so correct the existing one with experience_update_achievement instead of re-adding it.

context.description: How it was done, in a sentence or two.
